notes.title: Speedrun In-Game Timer Update!
notes.content:
Having asked the speed run community what features might help them, the biggest request is for an 'in-game-clock'.  This sets the standard by not relying on external timing equipment to time your run, making it less friction to record a speed run.

To use the Speed Run Timer:

1) Turn 'story mode' to 'OFF' in the options. This stops the main character appearing every ten levels (which would just waste time!).  

2) After every 'Epoch' (group of 20 levels) - as long as you started at level 1 - the timer will appear and show your total time for that epoch.  

3) Assuming you have completed all the levels without going back to the level-select screen, or retried any levels, then your time for the whole game also gets presented at the credits at the end, as well as your scores (how many lizards and petals you collected).

Unlike the normal level times, the speed run timer is not affected by hitting the edge.

The latest update also includes our new logo design!

notes.title: Squingle Beta v0.3.1 released!
notes.content:
Awesome feedback form our Beta testers, keep it up! New in v0.3.1

- Level curation: new ideas are presented earlier, levels have been reordered, repetition removed.
- UI enhancements - more legible and ergonomic
- Many tweaks/bug fixes.
- UI hints and some beginnings of a story added to level-complete screen.

Ideas for next release:

- more story - I'd like to bring up the main character at key times in the game to tell the story as you progress.
- more level curation and alteration based on Beta feedback (please!)
- curation of the environments and materials
- multiple save files

I'm very keen to know if you think the levels hold your attention more as they are now presented.  What are your favorite levels? Join our Beta program at www.squingle.com to join the journey!

notes.title: Squingle Beta v0.2.6 released!
notes.content:
Direct from your Beta-feedback this release sees quality-of-life improvements:

- comfort options (environment animation off/on)
- room-scale mode for those with larger spaces - it's super fun and a visual feast at double scale!
- alternative navigation controls (grip/index-trigger grab-and-pull)
- sound and sfx volume control
- sfx improvements
- all-new haptic engine
- revamped UI and level-complete screen
- visual and shader improvements

Planned for the next release:

- deeper curation of level content
- graphical improvements
- rewards
- multiple save files (maybe)

As always, thanks so much for helping to make Squingle the best it can be!  We are working hard to bring that trippy something to VR - your feedback has been absolutely amazing!  Keep it coming and sign up if you have not already to our Beta program at 
www.squingle.com
